```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(ggrepel)
```

```{r}
bctraits.all <- read.csv(here("Data", "cleaned", "BC_bird_traits.csv"))

```


```{r Fire Index}

index <- bctraits.all %>% 
  mutate(index_primary_lifestyle = ifelse(primary_lifestyle=="Insessorial"|for_hawking>51, 1, 0),
         index_primary_habitat = ifelse(primary_habitat == "Forest"|primary_habitat == "Woodland", -1, ifelse(primary_habitat == "Shrub"|primary_habitat == "Grassland"|primary_habitat == "Plains", 1, 0)),
         index_habitat_density = ifelse(habitat_density == "dense", -1, ifelse(habitat_density == "sparse", 1, 0)),
         index_forest_use = ifelse(forest_use == 1, -1, 0),
         #index_eco_spec_index = ifelse(eco_spec_index >1, -1,0),
         index_foraging_location = ifelse(most_common_foraging_location=="canopy", -1, ifelse(most_common_foraging_location=="ground"|most_common_foraging_location == "understory", 1, 0)),
         index_trophic_niche = ifelse(trophic_niche == "Invertivore"|trophic_niche == "Nectarivore"|trophic_niche == "Granivore"|trophic_niche=="Frugivore", 1, 0),
         # #20th percentile for range size will be considered "small"
         # index_range_size = ifelse(range_size<(quantile(range_size, probs = 0.20, na.rm =T)), -1, 0),
         index_migration = ifelse(migration == "sedentary", -1, 0),
         #index_kipps = ifelse(kipps_distance<(quantile(kipps_distance, probs = 0.20, na.rm =T)), -1, 0),
         index_snag_use = ifelse(snag_nest>51, 1, 0),
         index_oldgrowth = ifelse(old_growth == 1, -1, 0),
         index_nesting_location = ifelse(most_common_nesting_location =="ground"| most_common_nesting_location=="grass"| most_common_nesting_location == "shrub", 1, ifelse(live_tree_nest >51, -1, 0)),
         index_nest_type = ifelse(nest_category=="cavity", 1, 0),
         index_handwing = ifelse(hand_wing_index > mean(hand_wing_index, na.rm = TRUE), 1, 0),
         #index_groundforaging = ifelse(for_strat_ground>51, 1, 0),
        # index_canopyforaging = ifelse(for_strat_canopy>51, -1, 0),
         index_foliageglean = ifelse(for_foliage_gleaning>51, -1, 0),
         index_sum = rowSums(across(starts_with("index")), na.rm = TRUE))

#index$index_nesting_location[index$most_common_nesting_location == "tree" & index$nest_category == "cavity"] <- 1 #tree nesting is only positive if its cavity nesting
  
```


```{r index try 2}
index <- bctraits.all %>% 
  mutate(index_diet = ifelse(trophic_niche == "Invertivore"|trophic_niche == "Nectarivore"|trophic_niche == "Granivore"|trophic_niche=="Frugivore", 1, 
                           #  ifelse(primary_lifestyle == "Insessorial" & primary_diet == "Invertebrate", 1, #arboreal spp that eat on insects positively impacted
                                    ifelse(primary_lifestyle == "Insessorial" & trophic_niche == "Omnivore", 1, 0)),# omnivore arboreal spp  positively impacted
         #note the differences between primary_diet from the Nature data paper and trophic niche from avonet...
         index_nesting = ifelse(nest_type == "cavity"| most_common_nesting_location == "snag", 1, 
                                if_else(most_common_nesting_location == "tree", -1, #negaitvely impacted if they nest in live trees
                                        ifelse(most_common_nesting_location=="grass"|most_common_nesting_location == "shrub"|most_common_nesting_location == "ground", 1, 0))), # including ground as a postive
         index_migration = ifelse(migration == 3, -1, 0),

         index_sum = rowSums(across(starts_with("index")), na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}


# Create the figure: Lollipop Chart
# NOTE: Replace 'species' with the actual species column name if it is different
# We reorder the species (Y-axis) based on the index_sum (X-axis) for better visualization
(index1 <- ggplot(index, aes(x = index_sum, 
                  y = reorder(common_name, index_sum), 
                  color = index_sum)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.75)+
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = index_sum, y = reorder(common_name, index_sum), yend = reorder(common_name, index_sum)),
               linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = "red", mid = "gray", high = "blue", 
                        midpoint = 0, name = "Index Score") +
  labs(x = "Fire Vulnerability Index Score", y = "Species") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
   facet_wrap(~family, scales = "free_y")+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8), # Smaller font for potentially many species
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), # Remove horizontal lines for clean look
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ))
#Picidae

(woodpeckers <- index %>% filter(family == " Picidae") %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = index_sum, 
                  y = reorder(common_name, index_sum), 
                  color = index_sum)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = index_sum, y = reorder(common_name, index_sum), yend = reorder(common_name, index_sum)),
               linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = "red", mid = "gray", high = "blue", 
                        midpoint = 0, name = "Index Score") +
  labs(title = "Picidae", x = "Fire Vulnerability Index Score", y = "Species") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8), # Smaller font for potentially many species
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), # Remove horizontal lines for clean look
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ))

```

```{r}
family_summary <- index %>%
  group_by(family) %>%
  summarise(mean_index = mean(index_sum, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_index = sd(index_sum, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  arrange(family)

(family <- ggplot(family_summary, aes(x = mean_index, 
                           y = reorder(family, mean_index))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.75) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = mean_index - sd_index, 
                     xmax = mean_index + sd_index),
                 color = "gray30", height = 0.4, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(color = mean_index), size = 3) +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = "red", mid = "gray", high = "blue",
                        midpoint = 0, name = "Mean Index") +
  labs(x = "Fire Vulnerability Index Score",
       y = "Family") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.position = "bottom"))

ggsave(here("Figures", "index.familt errorbars.png"), plot = family, width = 8, height =8)

```
```{r}
# Select top 5 and bottom 5 species by index_sum
top_bottom <- index %>%
  arrange(desc(index_sum)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  bind_rows(
    index %>%
      arrange(index_sum) %>%
      slice_head(n = 10)
  ) %>% 
  filter(common_name != "Mexican Violetear", 
         common_name != "Calliope Hummingbird")

# Plot
(most <- ggplot(top_bottom, aes(
  x = reorder(common_name, index_sum),
  y = index_sum,
  fill = index_sum)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "C", name = "Index Sum") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    x = "Species",
    y = "Index",
    title = "Most affected species", fill = "Index"
  ))

ggsave(here("Figures", "index.most10.png"), plot = most, width = 8, height =8)

```
